title: SWF compiler: SymbolInstance instance name dropped when blend mode or filter is set
description:
In packages/swf/src/compile.ts, when a SymbolInstance has an instanceName AND either a blend mode or an active filter, the instance name is not encoded in the PlaceObject3 tag. This means _root.myInstance AS2 path resolution fails for instances that use Flash 8 blend modes or filters.

Root causes:
1. Filter-only path (lines ~2017-2026): encodePlaceObject3WithFilters() is called with 'undefined' for the name parameter even when displayObj.instanceName is set.
2. Blend mode path: encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode() has no name parameter at all — it never sets the HasName flag regardless of instanceName.

Text fields (TextDisplayObject with filters) are handled correctly at lines ~1783-1791 — they do pass the name. The bug only affects SymbolInstance.

Fix:
1. In the filter-only instance path, pass displayObj.instanceName as the name arg to encodePlaceObject3WithFilters().
2. Add an optional name parameter to encodePlaceObject3WithBlendMode() in packages/swf/src/filters.ts, set HasName flag when present, and emit the name string at the correct position (after MATRIX, before FilterList per PO3 field order). Then pass displayObj.instanceName from the call site in compile.ts.
